title: viola adunca subsp. oxyceras
intro: Viola adunca subsp. oxyceras, commonly known as pale mountain pansy, is a species of flowering plant in the violet family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Viola adunca subsp. oxyceras include its ability to calm and soothe the body, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
